title: ACC View
description: Read-only: the vehicle ahead (a gap level, closing), the cruise / limiter and later the outer loop's suggested set speed, drawn on the cluster's map target. Writes nothing to the car. A skeleton, off by default.

de.bmw.dass.GapVehicleAhead._about: r1120 AA: the vehicle ahead as the front camera reports it (a FIELD with a notifier only, 32770; no getter, no setter), declared 's' as Signal Probe and Twin Dial do. Watched only while 'show' is on. Read only.

de.bmw.infotainment.displaydataserver.Di._about: r1120 AA: cruise / limiter (ldmSym, ldmSymColor, cruiseCtrlSpeedHUD), seen on the car 2026-11-18. Getter 1 (non-zero), notifier 32769. Read only.

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.Vehicle2._about: r1120 AA: our own speed (raw x 0.015625 km/h), for the time-gap levels. Read only.

de.bmw.infotainment.fasus.FASuS._about: r1120 AA: the car's own collision-warning request, declared in Signal Probe (S14), never seen with a value: logged only; drawn (our picture dimmed) only when config.warn names its path and active values. Read only.

layer._about: r1120 AA (docs/r1120/AA-SPEC.md 2 and 7): one image layer 420 x 372 at (334, 44) of the map target. contend false: it waits until BMW's map leaves the slot and never pushes it aside (true = take the slot, the owner's decision). guideHold 0: BMW's CarPlay manoeuvre box is never held back for us.

warn._about: unknown until the car shows the struct: e.g. path ['someMember'], active ['SOME_ENUM']. Null: never drawn.
